ledger.claim: I do not press the waiting-period shortfall route, because the record closes it: the driver's own trace carries a single continuous in-geofence run of 500 seconds measured from the first qualifying fix (not from the 'arrived' marker), against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum, so the derived shortfall is minus 20 seconds and the effective dwell required by POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met. POL-NS-06 therefore refunds nothing and the rider seeks no full refund on that ground.

The rider did coordinate during the waiting window - 'I am walking over now.' sent at 22:41:40 - but the driver answered at 22:41:58, eighteen seconds later, so the rider-contact clause POL-NS-04 is unavailable by its own limb (b), which requires that the driver not reply within 120 seconds; a reply inside 120 seconds disables the clause regardless of the content of the reply, and I do not ask the Judge to refund the SGD 6.00 on this ground.

The wrong-entrance clause POL-NS-03 is not reached either: the driver's stationary point sits 24.01 m from the pickup pin, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius with all 51 fixes qualifying, and POL-NS-03's 400 m test runs only where the driver held position outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius. The pickup also records a single registered pickup point, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill limb is not open and the rider cannot claim the platform-funded goodwill figure carried in the fare breakdown.

The rider does not rely on the accumulated-dwell limb of POL-NS-06, and the rider makes no assertion against the advisory artifact: I disclose that EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is impaired and unusable - it is MISSING, carries no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING) - and POL-NS-06(i) needs a traffic advisory that is present and populated, so limb (i) is unavailable. There is in any event only one in-geofence interval on this trace, so no accumulation of dwell is sought.

ledger.claim: The driver arrived at the pickup point on his own trace. EV-GPS-09102 records 51 driver fixes, all 51 of them qualifying at the 25 m accuracy filter, at a mean distance of 24.01 m from the pickup pin specified in EV-TRIP-09102 — comfortably inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius and far past the three-consecutive-fix minimum. POL-NS-02 is satisfied.

The dwell requirement of POL-NS-01(c) is met on the same trace. The driver's longest continuous in-geofence run lasted 500 seconds, running from the first qualifying fix at 2026-09-02T22:40:00+08:00 to the cancellation at 22:48:20 — 20 seconds more than the 480 second AIRPORT minimum, so the published shortfall is negative, not positive. The dwell is measured from the first in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' marker, and even on that stricter reading it clears the bar.

Limb (d) closes on the trip record: EV-TRIP-09102 shows no boarding event, no start, and a termination by the driver at 2026-09-02T22:48:20+08:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — that is at, not before, the moment the 480 second minimum elapsed (22:40:00 plus 500 seconds). All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold.

POL-NS-05, the false-arrival marker clause, does not bite. At the 'arrived' timestamp of 22:40:20 the trace puts the driver 24.01 m from the pin, far under the 300 m ceiling, and the only distinct speed recorded in the whole trace is 0.0 km/h, far under the 15 km/h motion threshold. The arrival marker is true and the waiting clock is sound.

POL-NS-03, the wrong-entrance and wrong-block clause, is off the table. That clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m; this driver was stationary inside the 150 m radius. The pickup carries venue_id VEN-CHANGI-T3, the driver's chat states 'At T3 Door 5 ride-hail bay' — a party statement on the recorded location — and registered_pickup_points is 1, so there is no pin ambiguity to allocate to either party and no goodwill limb is engaged.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because it requires all three of its limbs and limb (b) plainly fails. The rider's coordinating message 'I am walking over now' was sent at 22:41:40 and read at 22:41:55; the driver answered at 22:41:58, 18 seconds later and well inside the 120 second window, having already posted 'At T3 Door 5 ride-hail bay' at 22:40:40 and no in-app call ever being needed. A reply within 120 seconds defeats the clause regardless of the content of the reply.

The rider's own track corroborates the no-show rather than the claim. Across 24 rider fixes spanning the entire waiting window (22:40:30 to 22:48:10) the rider's device sits at a constant 519.47 m from the pickup pin — outside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius — so limb (c) of POL-NS-04 cannot be made out on this record either. Even if the zero qualifying-fix count were read as making limb (c) undecidable rather than failed, the failure of limb (b) is independently decisive.

The rider's account that the driver 'cancelled while I was walking to the bay' is not supported by the seven minutes between the rider's 22:41:40 message and the 22:48:20 cancellation: the rider's device never closed on the bay, and no boarding event was ever recorded. The driver meanwhile honoured the commitment he posted — 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5' at 22:41:58 — and held position without moving a metre for the full 500 seconds.

POL-NS-06, the waiting-period shortfall clause, does not displace the fee, because the effective in-geofence dwell is not short of the 480 second AIRPORT minimum: it is 500 seconds. No accumulation of separate intervals is required, so the traffic-advisory limb is never reached. I record for completeness that EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload under issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; I do not rely on it, and its absence changes nothing on this arithmetic.

The fee amount reconciles with the schedule, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The resolution rule takes the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) — both dimensions produce SGD 6.00 — and fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is SGD 6.00. Each artifact carrying a deciding fact here (trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare breakdown) is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with an empty issues list, so nothing is down-weighted.

Compensation is payable to the driver under POL-NS-07: 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee is SGD 4.80, the figure EV-FARE-09102 publishes at derived.money.driver_compensation. The anti-farming gate does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, below the 0.08 ratio — so compensation is paid rather than withheld, and no other profile field may be read into that check.

The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION. Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION describes the disposition of the FEE — the charge stands as it presently is — but where POL-NS-07 compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, here the same SGD 4.80. That is the outcome this case produces: the rider's SGD 6.00 charge is undisturbed and the driver is paid SGD 4.80.

No escalation limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged. The anti-farming check does not trip; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so there is no repeat pairing between these parties; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; and the only impaired artifact (EV-ADVIS-09102-01, MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0) carries no deciding fact, which the GPS trace supplies at full weight. The case is decidable on the record and should not be held.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling concerns the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee charged after trip TRP-09102 on 2 September 2026.

To the rider: your dispute is not upheld on the evidence, and the SGD 6.00 charge stands. The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-09102, weight 1.0) places his vehicle 24.01 m from the Changi T3 Door 5 pickup pin from the first fix at 22:40:00, with all 51 fixes inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, so he did arrive under POL-NS-02. He then held position without moving for 500 seconds from 22:40:00 to 22:48:20, which is 20 seconds more than the 480-second AIRPORT minimum, and that dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' marker, exactly as POL-NS-01(c) requires. The trip record (EV-TRIP-09102) shows no boarding event and a driver cancellation at 22:48:20 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, at or after the dwell elapsed (POL-NS-01(d)). Your account that the driver 'cancelled while I was walking to the bay' is not what the record shows: your own device logged 24 fixes from 22:40:30 to 22:48:10 at a constant 519.47 m from the pin, outside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius. The waiting-period shortfall clause (POL-NS-06) does not refund you because there was no shortfall - the effective dwell of 500 seconds clears the 480-second bar, and no accumulation of separate intervals is needed. The rider-contact clause (POL-NS-04) is closed because the driver replied to your 22:41:40 message at 22:41:58, 18 seconds later, inside the 120-second window that disables the clause, and the wrong-entrance clause (POL-NS-03) does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. The driver's statement that he waited more than eight minutes at Door 5 and replied immediately is consistent with the instruments; it carries no weight of its own in the confidence calculation.

To the driver: your compensation is payable. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 pays you 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, which is SGD 4.80, the figure EV-FARE-09102 publishes at derived.money.driver_compensation. The anti-farming check is passed: your no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 ratio, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. The rider's SGD 6.00 charge is undisturbed and only the compensation moves; under POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at the same SGD 4.80.

On confidence and integrity: every artifact that carries a deciding fact - the trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare breakdown and driver profile - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, and none is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): the arrival timestamp matches a GPS fix exactly, the trace has 51 fixes and no gap over 120 seconds, the chat log holds the 4 messages the trip record counts and no gap over five minutes, and the SGD 6.00 fee reconciles with the POL-NS-01 resolution rule, which takes the greater of the SGD 6.00 AIRPORT zone-class fee and the SGD 6.00 RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee. The only impaired artifact, EV-ADVIS-09102-01 (MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no deciding fact, so it neither caps the confidence nor escalates the case. No limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other, the parties show no repeat no-show pairing in the trailing 90 days, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the only impaired artifact is not the sole evidence for any deciding fact. No clause produces a referral on these facts: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker is true (24.01 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h), and the POL-NS-07 escalation packet is not generated because the anti-farming gate does not trip.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
